chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Yunus ibn Yaqoub, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'From which mosque shall I enter into Ihram on the Day of Tarwiyya?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'From whichever mosque you desire.'

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdullah (referring to Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.أُحْرِمُ: I enter into the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj)
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: The Day of Tarwiyya (8th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: Where should a pilgrim enter Ihram on the Day of Tarwiyya?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the pilgrim is not restricted to a specific mosque for entering the state of Ihram on the 8th of Dhu al-Hijjah, emphasizing flexibility in the ritual's commencement. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly view that the sanctity of the Ihram state is tied to the intention and location relative to the Miqat boundaries rather than a singular designated mosque, allowing for ease in pilgrimage practices.
